issues.detail: Original raw iron nail requirement was missed. Parent deterministic raster correction retains paid source, crops extra handle and rotates original iron pixels; corrected native PNG was read by this owner and now reads as a real iron nail. No extra generation.
Source objects do not touch frame but many have less than the prompted 12% top/bottom padding. Native normalization retains complete object and >=8px output padding.
Wide crowns reduce output content height (43:159px, 46:170px) instead of stretching or clipping.

Initial source blade/grip ratios often look short-sword-like. Main chose full-image proportional 112x176 maximum content bounds for all daggers, centered on 128x256. No blade cropping or distortion; final aggregate normalize owns consistent runtime/codex scale.

Generator violated no-green lock on a small guard loop beside poison vessels. Keying removes that local green detail; blade, guard and grip remain complete. Main documented and accepted this deviation without extra generation.

Initial cyan-gray ring concern was reviewed by Main on the native PNG. Metal ring remains readable; alpha is binary and opaque, not semi-transparent. Preserve original structure without extra despill or recolor.
Initial contact Chinese labels rendered as missing-glyph boxes; index/id remain readable. Main is re-rendering final aggregate contacts with installed CJK font.

approval: All 36 original images and all 3 native contacts were read. Distinct structural forms documented per item; source hashes alone were not treated as design acceptance. Main owns final corrected contacts and in-game acceptance.
